title: The waiting page gets its final look, in every repo at once
why: Your worry, Oct 26: "is it already too late to decide the look ... I realize i allowed a beta to be the final product". It is not too late: every repo's page comes from one template, skills/waiting-page/page.html.
note: Final design drafted (Oct 26, 20:15 CDT): https://claude.ai/artifact/2DodmME3zxVTmi26B3KzBR, source plans/waiting-mockups/final-combined.html. It combines the five mockups on shiv's answers (Oct 26, 20:01-20:05 CDT): one stable list, no one-at-a-time view; repo colour as a full header, tinted ground and contrast-checked ink, never the whole page; nothing preselected (shiv reversed that Oct 26 20:39 CDT; my pick is marked, Take my pick fills it in one tap) and one Send with a stamp and Undo; tiers named Blocking, Upcoming, Whenever; phone and Mac equally; no key hints on screen. Template changes: identity in meta/page, new item fields holds, by and related, one Send replacing per-card Save and Accept every pick (closes c74), receipts trail (needs c99), CDT times, Atkinson type. Later rulings (Oct 26, 20:34-20:37 CDT): the header is one slim 44px sticky colour bar with flat counts; a repo with no colour gets one drawn from its name, clear of the state hues and the other repos' hues, and the same wheel guides a repo that adopts its own colours (c105). Oct 26 20:40 CDT: related items sit together in one frame with one sentence on how they connect (new groups record); each tier word appears once, as its section heading (c106). Oct 26 20:42 CDT: state colours turn away from a repo hue within 30 degrees and reach 4.5:1 on every surface; the Blocking line is a solid red fill. Next: shiv's look, then a build lane on skills/waiting-page. Port: yes, through the skill. Oct 26 22:58 CDT (version 9): the left rail is an overview (progress and counts), not a second list of questions; a Designs tab holds each open question's full mockup inline, with a preview on its card (Design tab step in the outbox).
